name: Hand Betting Game
subtitle: Real-Time Mahjong Prediction Engine
points: Built a high-performance Mahjong betting engine featuring real-time prediction logic and dynamic tile valuation.
Developed a custom Virtual DOM framework (PicoJS) to achieve sub-millisecond UI updates and predictable state management.
Engineered a concurrent Go backend following Domain-Driven Design (DDD) to handle game logic, session validation, and real-time scaling.
Implemented a real-time 'valuation scaling' system where tile values evolve based on global win/loss outcomes.
Architected a secure session management layer with rate-limiting and JWT-based authentication.
Containerized the entire stack using Docker for seamless production deployment and environment parity.

name: FlowGrid
subtitle: Autonomous Intersection Simulation (Rust + SDL2)
points: Architected a real-time autonomous traffic simulation in Rust to optimize four-way intersection throughput without traditional traffic lights.
Implemented a deterministic reservation-based scheduler that coordinates vehicle entry times into 6x6 conflict zones.
Developed a high-precision collision detection engine using Oriented Bounding Boxes (OBB) and the Separating Axis Theorem (SAT).
Engineered a fairness-aware priority model that considers wait time, queue depth, and aging to prevent starvation.
Built an interactive visualization layer using SDL2 with procedural road rendering and directional car texture mapping.
Included detailed performance analytics tracking metrics such as completion time, waiting intervals, and close-call frequency.

name: Blast Arena
subtitle: Multiplayer Bomb-Battle Arena
points: Developed a fast-paced multiplayer arena game with real-time synchronization over WebSockets using Node.js.
Implemented a destructible grid environment and power-up system with precise collision and proximity logic.
Built a synchronized lobby system supporting four-player sessions with live chat and 'ready-up' states.
Utilized a custom reactive UI layer (PicoJS) for lightweight client-side rendering and minimal bundle size.
Engineered a robust backend game loop with server-side validation to ensure competitive integrity and state consistency.

name: Smart Streetlights
subtitle: IoT-Based Intelligent Road Lighting System
points: The current streetlight control methods in Bahrain lack precision and environmental sensing, prompting engineers to reassess the standard to find cost-effective solutions for smart road lighting.
The project aims to develop an intelligent lighting system that improves the existing streetlight functionality.
To address this, an Arduino controller and motion detection sensors will be used to activate streetlights based on traffic conditions.
Additionally, the project will compare energy consumption between high-pressure sodium lights and LEDs.
Implementing an intelligent street lighting system saves energy, extends lighting lifespan, and reduces maintenance costs.
It optimizes lighting by avoiding unnecessary usage when no vehicles or pedestrians are present.

name: GigaBit
subtitle: Real-Time Social Network (Go + Next.js)
points: Built GigaBit, a Full-Stack Development project featuring a real-time social networking platform that covers the complete surface area of a modern community application, from authentication and privacy controls to live communication and group collaboration.
Profiles with public/private visibility, follow requests, and approval flows.
Content system including posts with media, threaded comments, reactions, bookmarks, shares, and polls.
Community features such as groups with roles and permissions, invitations, gated membership, group posts, and events with RSVP handling.
Real-time capabilities using WebSockets for private and group messaging, typing indicators, notifications, online status, and live feed updates.
Relational data model using SQLite to support the social graph and interaction workflows.

name: 01 Dashboard
subtitle: Personal Learning Analytics Platform (React + Typescript + GraphQL)
points: 01 Dashboard is a web-based analytics dashboard built to visualize and analyze learning progress on the reboot01 platform.
The project aggregates data related to XP, projects, audits, and timelines, presenting it in a clear and structured way to help users better understand their learning patterns over time.
The dashboard consumes real data through a GraphQL API and uses Apollo Client for efficient querying, caching, and request batching.
Authentication is secured using JWT, with token refresh logic to maintain stable user sessions.
From a front-end perspective, the project focuses on clarity and usability.
Interactive charts and visual summaries are used to represent progress, audit performance, and project distribution, while a responsive layout ensures the dashboard works well across devices.

name: Connecthub RT
subtitle: Real-Time Forum & Chat Application
points: Connecthub RT is a real-time web application built with Go that combines a traditional discussion forum with live communication features.
The platform supports posts, comments, categories, and private messaging, allowing users to interact without the delays typically found in standard forum systems.
The backend is structured around Go's concurrency model and WebSocket communication, enabling instant updates for comments, online status, and private chats.
Persistent data such as users, posts, and messages is managed using SQLite, keeping the architecture simple while still reflecting real-world application design.
The project focuses on practical backend concepts, including session handling, secure password hashing, and real-time connection management.
The frontend uses HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to deliver a responsive interface that works smoothly across devices.

name: PicoJS Framework
subtitle: Reactive UI Framework (JavaScript)
points: Built PicoJS Framework, a lightweight JavaScript framework created to explore and implement the core mechanics behind modern UI libraries in a clean and readable codebase.
The project focuses on understanding how reactive state, Virtual DOM rendering, and event handling work together to keep user interfaces predictable and efficient.
Virtual DOM diffing with minimal DOM patching.
Reactive state management with automatic re-renders.
Centralized event delegation for better performance and cleanup.
Path-based routing that stays in sync with application state.
Includes a complete TodoMVC demo demonstrating real-world usage.

name: 01 ConnectHub
subtitle: Full-Stack Web Forum Application
points: 01 ConnectHub is a full-stack web forum application built with Go, tailored to support structured community discussions and meaningful user interaction.
The platform allows users to register, create posts, participate in discussions through comments, and engage with content using likes and dislikes, all within a moderated and secure environment.
The application implements a complete authentication system, including secure password hashing and OAuth2 social login using Google and GitHub.
Role-based access control enables administrators and moderators to manage users and content effectively.
From a technical perspective, the project focuses heavily on backend architecture, session management, and data persistence.
Server-side rendering is powered by Go, while the frontend is built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

name: HarmonyHub
subtitle: Music & Concert Discovery Platform
points: HarmonyHub is a web application engineered in Go that brings together music artists and their concert information in a single, structured platform.
The application aggregates artist profiles, band members, formation details, and performance schedules using data retrieved from an external REST API.
The project focuses on clean server-side architecture, structured data handling, and clear presentation of API-driven content.
Artist and concert data are processed using Go structs and rendered through server-side templates, ensuring reliability, performance, and maintainability.

name: AntFinder
subtitle: Graph Pathfinding Simulation in Go
points: AntFinder is a terminal-based application programmed in Go that simulates efficient pathfinding for ant colonies moving through a graph.
The project focuses on discovering optimal routes and coordinating the movement of multiple ants from a start node to an end node while minimizing the total number of turns.
The application applies classic graph algorithms, including Depth-First Search (DFS), to explore and evaluate possible paths.
Ant movement is simulated step by step, ensuring conflict-free traversal and balanced path assignment.

name: GoTalk
subtitle: Concurrent TCP Chat Server
points: GoTalk is a TCP-based chat server architected in Go, optimized to support real-time communication between multiple terminal clients.
The application allows users to connect concurrently, exchange messages instantly, and interact within a shared chat environment.

The project focuses on core systems programming concepts, including concurrent client handling using goroutines, message broadcasting through shared channels, and reliable network communication via TCP sockets.
Each message is timestamped, users are uniquely identified, and chat activity is persisted through server-side logging.

name: Space Blaster
subtitle: Browser-Based Arcade Game
points: Space Blaster is a browser-based space shooter built using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, inspired by classic arcade games.
Players control a spaceship to navigate enemy waves, fire lasers, and build their score in real time.
The project emphasizes smooth gameplay, responsive keyboard controls, and clear game-state management.
Enemy movement, collision detection, scoring, and lives are orchestrated through structured JavaScript logic and DOM manipulation.
Audio effects are integrated to enhance immersion without relying on external libraries.

name: ASCII Forge
subtitle: ASCII Art Generator Web Application
points: ASCII Forge is a web-based application implemented in Go that converts plain text into stylized ASCII art using multiple banner formats, including standard, shadow, and thinkertoy.
The application provides a clean and intuitive interface that allows users to generate creative text representations directly from the browser.
The project focuses on server-side text processing and dynamic content generation, handling banner parsing and rendering logic efficiently.
Users can export the generated ASCII output as text files, making it easy to reuse or share across different platforms.

name: This personal Website
subtitle: Interactive Portfolio & Resume Website
points: Built this comprehensive personal portfolio website showcasing professional experience, technical skills, and project work as an Electrical Engineer and Full-Stack Developer.
The website features an interactive timeline visualization of career progression, detailed project showcases, and a responsive design that works seamlessly across all devices.
Implemented modern web technologies including dynamic content rendering, smooth animations, and interactive elements to create an engaging user experience.
Integrated contact forms, downloadable resume, and vCard functionality for easy professional networking.
The site serves as both a professional showcase and a demonstration of web development capabilities, built entirely with vanilla JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.

name: OxideShell
subtitle: Standalone Unix Shell in Pure Rust
points: Architected a minimalist, Unix-like command shell implemented entirely from scratch in Rust.
Engineered zero-dependency internal command execution paths for pwd, cd, echo, ls, cat, cp, mv, rm, and mkdir.
Implemented robust state-machine lexical parsing for single/double quotes, escape characters, and environment variables.
Handled POSIX signal traps (SIGINT / Ctrl+C) to prevent shell crashes during active sessions.

name: ApexVault
subtitle: Terminal Financial Management & Banking Engine
points: Developed a robust terminal-based banking and account management system in C.
Built a centered Text User Interface (TUI) featuring double-line ASCII borders, arrow-key navigation, and instant ESC cancellation.
Implemented secure user authentication with password masking and multi-account ledger persistence (Savings, Fixed, Current).
Engineered financial deposit/withdrawal routines with real-time balance validation and dynamic monthly interest calculations.

name: ChronosVault
subtitle: Automated Background Backup Daemon & Scheduler
points: Engineered an automated Python background backup daemon and schedule orchestration manager.
Implemented a non-blocking background daemon loop that polls schedule queues and executes timed compressed archiving.
Created a CLI suite for schedule creation, queue inspection, deletion, and daemon lifecycle management (start/stop).
Built process PID file tracking (.chronos_daemon.pid) and structured operational logging for CLI and daemon transactions.

name: Linux Sysadmin Lab
subtitle: Virtual Subnetting, SSH Hardening & Network Auditing Lab
points: Architected a multi-node virtualized infrastructure environment on Debian Linux using UTM/QEMU hypervisor.
Engineered an isolated host-only virtual subnet (192.168.64.0/24) with static IP reservations and gateway routing.
Hardened Linux operating systems, user privilege namespaces, and terminal session security (multi-TTY signal trapping).
Configured host port-forwarding and hardened OpenSSH daemons to non-standard ports (4242) with strict UFW firewall policies.
Conducted network reconnaissance and penetration testing audits using arp-scan, Nmap TCP SYN sweeps, and service fingerprinting.

name: VisionPulse
subtitle: Real-Time Computer Vision & Visual Analytics (FastAPI + YOLOv8 + Win98 UI)
points: Developed an industrial-grade computer vision monitoring suite powered by FastAPI, YOLOv8, and a retro Windows 98 React frontend.
Implemented multi-source video ingestion supporting hardware webcams, IP/RTSP streams, file uploads, and benchmark datasets.
Engineered a real-time Web Audio Synthesizer and visual alert system for zone occupancy threshold breaches.
Built interactive telemetry dashboards with pure SVG vector trend lines, 24-hour crowd histograms, and SQLite historical CSV logging.

name: GridTactix
subtitle: Algorithmic Territory Control Game Bot
points: Engineered a competitive algorithmic game bot in Rust for spatial grid territory domination.
Implemented a dynamic greedy strategy tracking opponent Center of Mass to choke expansion trajectories.
Utilized Euclidean distance predictors sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2) to select optimal piece placements across dynamic coordinate planes.
Enforced strict mathematical overlap rules (Rule of One, Rule of Zero, boundary checks) over STDIN/STDOUT stream protocols.

name: OmniKnowledge
subtitle: Enterprise RAG Assistant (FastAPI + FAISS + React + Ollama)
points: Built an enterprise Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) assistant combining local FAISS vector search and FastAPI.
Designed a dual in-memory embedding cache with MD5 document chunk hashing in SQLite, achieving 100% cache hits for unchanged files.
Rendered interactive inline citations ([1], [2]) that dynamically highlight source document cards and raw text snippets.
Supported multi-provider LLM backends including OpenAI, Gemini, and 100% offline local inference via Ollama (Llama 3.2).

name: ServOxide
subtitle: Single-Threaded Non-Blocking HTTP/1.1 Web Server in Rust
points: Architected a single-threaded, non-blocking HTTP/1.1 web server in Rust using pure libc system calls.
Engineered a single OS multiplexed event loop (epoll on Linux, kqueue on macOS) enforcing one read/write per tick.
Built a hand-written NGINX-style configuration parser supporting virtual hosts, static routing, autoindexing, and custom error pages.
Implemented a CGI process spawner (fork + execve) with pipe I/O, environment mapping, and 128-bit session cookie tracking.

name: MindQuest
subtitle: Interactive Assessment & Quiz Management Platform
points: Built a full-stack assessment platform and quiz management system engineered with PHP and Laravel.
Implemented secure user authentication, profile dashboards, and role-based quiz creation workflows.
Engineered question bank models with multiple-choice options, real-time score grading, and attempt history.
Constructed dynamic global leaderboards ranking top user performances across quiz categories.

name: VectorMaze3D
subtitle: Multiplayer 3D Raycasting FPS Game (Rust + Macroquad + UDP)
points: Developed a retro multiplayer 3D first-person shooter in Rust using the Macroquad engine and custom DDA raycasting.
Engineered custom raycasting wall projections and wireframe diamond avatars without external 3D engine libraries.
Implemented a low-latency UDP network loop synchronizing player positions, lasers, and scoreboards at a 30Hz tick rate.
Built a graphical connection launcher with host history persistence, match lobby controls, and smart AI bot fillers.

name: FixLink
subtitle: Home Services Marketplace Platform (Django + Bootstrap)
points: Engineered a full-stack home services marketplace web platform using Python, Django, and Bootstrap.
Architected dual persona workflows for Customer Accounts and Service Provider Companies.
Built service catalog management, quote requests, appointment scheduling, and order status tracking (Pending -> Completed).
Designed a relational SQLite data model with Django ORM binding customers, company profiles, and requested service orders.

name: StackSort
subtitle: Dual-Stack Sorting Algorithm Generator & Verifier
points: Engineered a high-efficiency dual-stack sorting algorithm generator and verifier in Go.
Calculated minimal instruction sequences (pa, pb, sa, sb, ra, rb, rra, rrb) to sort integer lists across two stacks.
Achieved strict algorithmic constraints (<=3 ops for 3 elements, <=12 for 5, <=1500 for 100, <=11500 for 500).
Built a companion verification binary (checker) that executes instruction streams against initial stack states.

name: RayCraft3D
subtitle: Concurrent 3D Ray Tracer in Pure Rust
points: Engineered a concurrent 3D ray tracing engine in pure Rust without external math or graphics crates.
Implemented multithreaded row-parallel rendering using CPU-scoped threads (std::thread::scope).
Developed Blinn-Phong specular shading, direct shadows, metallic reflections, and Snell's law glass refractions.
Created procedural checkerboard textures, sinusoidal fluid normal wave maps, and a custom .rt scene file parser.

name: MarketPulse
subtitle: Full-Stack E-Commerce Marketplace (Rails + Bulma)
points: Built a full-stack e-commerce marketplace web application using Ruby on Rails and Bulma CSS.
Implemented authentication and seller ad creation with CarrierWave product image uploads.
Designed storefront product grid cards featuring direct seller attribution and strict ownership authorization guards.
Engineered session-persistent shopping carts (CurrentCart concern), quantity adjustments, and simulated checkout flows.

name: ResourceFlow
subtitle: Process Scheduling & Resource Allocation Simulator
points: Developed a process scheduling and resource allocation optimization simulator in Go.
Parsed process dependency manifests defining initial stock levels, cycle durations, input prerequisites, and output yields.
Engineered a virtual demand scheduler to unblock dependent downstream processes and prevent inventory starvation.
Built cycle-accurate event log tracing (.log output) and a companion log validation checker binary.

name: SysPulse
subtitle: Cross-Platform System Performance Dashboard (C++ + ImGui + SDL2)
points: Engineered a cross-platform desktop system monitor utility in C++ using Dear ImGui and SDL2/OpenGL3.
Interfaced directly with OS kernel APIs (macOS mach/sysctl/IOKit, Linux /proc, Windows Win32/psapi).
Built interactive process tables with multi-column sorting, PID search filtering, and memory consumption metrics.
Rendered 60 FPS visual trend line graphs for CPU utilization, thermal sensors (°C), fan RPMs, and network RX/TX traffic.

name: TetraOpt
subtitle: Backtracking Shape Optimization & Polyomino Packer
points: Developed a backtracking polyomino shape optimization engine in Go.
Parsed ASCII grid tetromino descriptors, validating connectivity using Depth-First Search (DFS) graph algorithms.
Generated unique rotational symmetry variations while filtering redundant spatial orientations.
Implemented a recursive backtracking solver finding the minimal 2D square grid fit starting from theoretical lower bounds.

name: FetchCraft
subtitle: Command-Line File Retrieval & Website Mirroring Engine
points: Built a command-line file downloader and website mirroring utility written in Go.
Implemented real-time progress bar rendering with ANSI escape sequences, byte formatting, speed tracking, and ETA calculations.
Designed a rate-limiting reader wrapper for bandwidth throttling (--rate-limit) and background daemonization (-B).
Engineered a BFS website crawler for recursive mirroring (--mirror) with path exclusions (-X) and relative link conversion.

name: TaskI
subtitle: Secure Task Management Application (Go + React)
points: Built a secure, modular ToDo application featuring a concurrent Go REST API backend and a responsive React frontend.
Architected robust authentication with rate-limiting, temporary IP-based lockouts, and stateful JWT revocation on logout.
Utilized PostgreSQL with schema migration versioning and clean Domain-Driven Design (DDD) backend layering.
Containerized application stack with Docker Compose for seamless environment parity.
